summary: The retiring mayor sounds grateful and a little wistful, thanks family, council, staff and the town, and says the work belongs to everyone, not to a legacy.
realLife: Three retiring mayors gave their last address in a reflective, thankful voice. They thanked the council, staff and residents, spoke of what the city rebuilt, and gave the credit away; one said the legacy was not his alone and another quoted a line about leaving the place a bit better. All ended on thanks and good wishes for the town.
sources: Bob Crowell, Carson City NV mayor, final State of the City address, Jan 24, 2020: https://www.carsonnow.org/01/24/2020/carson-city-s-mayor-bob-crowell-delivers-his-last-state-city-address
A. George Pradel, Naperville IL mayor, final State of the City address, Jan 2015 (as reported by Patch): https://patch.com/illinois/naperville/mayor-george-pradel-gives-final-state-city-address-0
